metaTitle: Jaguar Nationwide Engine Recovery | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Professional Jaguar nationwide engine recovery and collection service. We collect your Jaguar from anywhere in the UK with a failed engine and transport it safely to our workshop.
lede: We collect your Jaguar from anywhere in the UK and bring it to our specialist workshop.

blocks.html: When your Jaguar's engine has failed and the vehicle is not drivable, we arrange nationwide recovery to bring it to our workshop. Our service covers every step from your initial instruction to the safe delivery of your Jaguar into our workshop for inspection.

We use flatbed transporters exclusively—the only method recommended by Jaguar—to protect your vehicle's drivetrain, suspension, and bodywork during transit. Whether you're at home, at the roadside, or at another garage, we'll collect your Jaguar and transport it securely to our Essex workshop.

paras: **Recovery costs are quoted per job** – we provide fixed-price quotes based on your location and vehicle, with no hidden fees. Recovery can be included as part of an engine rebuild or replacement quote.

steps.title: Booking & Instruction
steps.body: You contact us with your vehicle's location and condition. We confirm the details and arrange the collection.

steps.title: Dispatch
steps.body: We dispatch a flatbed recovery vehicle to your location, typically within 24–48 hours.

steps.title: Vehicle Loading
steps.body: The driver prepares your Jaguar (releasing the electronic parking brake, setting gear to neutral, fitting the towing eye) and winches it onto the flatbed using ramps to protect low-clearance models.

steps.title: Secure Transport
steps.body: Your Jaguar is secured with heavy-duty straps and transported nationwide. AWD models are handled with extra care to prevent transmission damage.

steps.title: Arrival & Handover
steps.body: At our workshop, we carefully unload your Jaguar, inspect it, and prepare it for the next stage – whether that's a full engine rebuild, replacement, or diagnostic assessment.

steps.title: Next Steps
steps.body: We'll contact you to discuss the findings and provide a transparent quote for the required work.

items.q: How does nationwide engine recovery work?
items.a: We dispatch a flatbed recovery vehicle to your location, carefully load your Jaguar onto the transporter, secure it, and transport it to our workshop for inspection and repair.

items.q: How long does it take to collect my Jaguar?
items.a: We typically arrange collection within 24–48 hours of booking, depending on your location and our availability. Transit time varies by distance.

items.q: Can you recover my Jaguar from anywhere in the UK?
items.a: Yes, we offer nationwide recovery across the UK. For Scotland, Ireland, and Europe, additional time and costs may apply.

items.q: Is the recovery service included with an engine rebuild?
items.a: We can include recovery as part of your engine rebuild or replacement quote. Contact us to discuss your specific needs.

items.q: What type of recovery vehicle do you use?
items.a: We use flatbed (rollback) transporters only – this is the recommended method for Jaguars to avoid drivetrain and underbody damage.
